label: Wednesday, November 4, 2026 · Blue-wave rally edition
intro: Democrats swept both chambers of Congress on Election Night, and Wall Street woke up to it: stocks, bonds and gold all rallying while the dollar slid. Today's tape shows Tuesday's quiet close, but futures were sharply higher ahead of the bell.

items.title: Democratic sweep heralds 'a new political era' — stocks and bonds rise, dollar falls
items.take: Democrats took both chambers of Congress in a midterm sweep, and global markets bid risk on: stocks and bonds rose while the dollar fell. Gold pushed back above $4,000 as traders price a slower pace of tax cuts and a check on the Trump agenda.

items.title: Democrats seize Congress; AMD shares surge — what's moving markets
items.take: Democrats swept statewide races even in traditional Republican strongholds, after voters punished the White House over affordability and the Iran war. Wednesday brings earnings from Arm Holdings and Qualcomm to test whether the chip rally has legs.

items.title: AMD stock jumps 8% on earnings as data center revenue nearly doubles
items.take: AMD beat on both lines ($2.09 adjusted EPS, $13.38B revenue) and guided stronger, saying data-center chips will drive 80% of sales. Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI, Oracle and Anthropic are all starting to use its Helios racks, and AMD has committed up to $5B to Anthropic.

items.title: Blue wave sweeps the nation: futures rise, gold tops $4K, Anthropic 'gobbling up' compute
items.take: Anthropic's amended S-1 shows Q3 revenue of $16.8B, up from $11.6B in Q2, and the company is buying compute aggressively ahead of a potentially historic IPO. Meta launched its debut euro bond sale, extending the AI borrowing spree. TD Securities called bonds the clear winner of the sweep.

items.title: Dow climbs as Democrats take House and Senate; Trump warns he'll 'just veto everything'
items.take: Intraday Wednesday the Dow was up more than 2% and the S&P 500 back over 7,670, with health insurers and hospital operators the clear Democratic-policy winners while energy lagged. Trump congratulated Democrats, then warned about a veto wall — divided government is now part of the market math.

items.title: Podcast: The Markets — Bullish options trades slow amid AI uncertainty
items.take: This week's pick from the rotation: Goldman's traders-desk podcast on why bullish options positioning is cooling as the AI trade gets re-priced, a useful counterweight to today's relief rally.
